description: A signed-in reader opens a story from the personalized feed.
A reader reveals another batch of stories in a feed section.
A signed-in reader rates a story from the return-to-feed prompt.
A signed-in reader successfully saves their onboarding preferences.
A signed-in reader saves updated feed preferences.
A signed-in reader changes a previous story reaction.
A visitor successfully subscribes through an inline, feed-header, or article-gate form; the placement property distinguishes them.
A visitor dismisses the article subscription gate.
A visitor successfully shares or copies a Wortins story link.
A visitor shares a story image to a social platform or downloads its card.
